description_zh: 用马斯克的视角看世界：10 个心智模型、18 条决策启发式、伪语录防伪。遇到生意/工程/风险/组织问题，先算数、先查证，再下判断。
description_en: Think like Elon Musk: 10 mental models, 18 decision heuristics, and a quote-forgery detector. For business/engineering/risk/org questions, compute first, then judge.
examples_zh: 用马斯克的视角看，这个生意能不能做大？
帮我算算这颗高端路由器的理论成本下限。
我们团队在优化审批流程，加了好多自动化，对吗？
我想抵押房子去融资 all in 一个项目，靠谱吗？
马斯克说过'设计是它如何运作'吗？这句是他的吗？
examples_en: From Musk's perspective, can this business scale?
Help me compute the theoretical cost floor of this device.
My team is adding automation to a process—are we doing it right?
Should I mortgage my house to go all-in on this project?
Did Musk actually say 'design is how it works'?
